records.title: Context-Aware Hierarchical Merging for Long Document Summarization
records.reason: Context-aware hierarchical merging improves factuality in long-document summarization; the reported outcome is summarization quality, not reduced inference cost.

records.title: Improving Factuality with Explicit Working Memory
records.reason: EWE adds explicit working memory and retrieval feedback to improve factuality in long-form generation; the abstract reports quality gains, not inference efficiency.

records.title: NoVo: Norm Voting off Hallucinations with Attention Heads in Large Language Models
records.reason: NoVo uses attention-head norms for inference-only factuality voting and reports accuracy gains; it does not establish reduced latency, compute, memory, or serving cost.

records.title: LPZero: Language Model Zero-cost Proxy Search from Zero
records.reason: LPZero searches zero-cost proxies for neural architecture ranking and evaluates downstream ranking quality; its efficiency target is NAS search, not deployed LLM inference.

records.title: Data Center Power and Energy Management: Past, Present, and Future
records.reason: This article surveys cloud data-center power and energy management broadly; the abstract does not establish a specific LLM inference/serving method or result.
